title: Run in the repaired top end and record follow-up maintenance
completeness: Illustrated maintenance companion; not a stand-alone all-joint access or internal fit diagnostic. Actual required inspections and repairs must be recorded before completion.
entry_state: Exact stock top-end repair assembled and stationary commissioning accepted.
exit_state: Actual break-in and required follow-up maintenance recorded only when all physical checks and repairs accepted.

applicability.included: US2026 stock YZ450F after new valves/piston/rings or cylinder.

preflight: Have original illustrated manual and torque-check sheet available.
Arrange qualified assessment for required inaccessible checks or checks outside operator capability.
Do not record work as completed unless physically performed.

required_tools.name: Secure wheel stands; metric tools; torque equipment2.5–145Nm
Clean oil collection/measurement tools, timer and oil-temperature measurement means
Original diagrams/torque tables and repair/inspection record

required_parts.name: New oil filter, filter O-ring, drain gaskets, filler O-ring and left-cover gasket
Specified engine oil, foam-filter cleaner/oil, lithium-soap/silicone grease, cable/chain lubricant

critical_stop_conditions: Oil debris, flow failure, leaks or abnormal running
Unresolved fit assessment or required inaccessible check
Generator looseness/contact damage or control fault

source.review_note: Independent yamaha_workshop_evidence reviewed riding, oil/filter, generator and corrected tank/body/torque sequence. Approved only as illustrated maintenance companion with required actual external tank-cleaning/fit/all-joint checks; not stand-alone complete maintenance coverage.

steps.title: Accept the completed repair
steps.instruction: Start only after the exact stock top-end job has accepted cold clearances, timing, fluid flow/levels, idle, controls and assembled-bike closure. Record the actual replaced parts and repair record. Unresolved noise, leakage or lubrication concerns require repair before riding.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Choose the actual parts route
steps.instruction: New valves, piston or rings require about30 minutes at no more than half throttle. A new cylinder requires about one hour: the source sequence is20 minutes at no more than half throttle, an inspection stop, then40 minutes at no more than three-quarter throttle and another inspection. If cylinder and valves/piston/rings are new together, preserve half throttle for at least the first30 minutes. That overlap is an explicit conservative workflow adaptation, not another Yamaha schedule.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Open filter access
steps.instruction: Release the sub-seat quick fastener. Press the intake-duct side inward, release both cover ribs, lift its rear and slide rearward out of the front projection. Release the retaining band and move the bracket in the PDF101–102 arrow direction. Withdraw filter/guide together and separate the filter, guide and seal. Leave the bracket mounted.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Clean and oil the foam
steps.instruction: Wash with air-filter cleaner or kerosene, squeeze without twisting and dry fully. Replace damaged foam. Work Yamaha or quality foam-filter oil evenly through the foam in a bag; wipe excess with a clean cloth. It must be wet throughout but not dripping. Do not use gasoline or the source-prohibited volatile cleaners.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Restore the sealed intake
steps.instruction: Fit seal/filter to the guide and grease the entire seal lips with lithium-soap grease. Move the bracket rearward, engage the guide projection with it and secure the other projection in the band. Engage cover projection and both ribs. Restore the breather through guide/groove, protected end in steering shaft and other end on cap. Secure sub-seat with tether untwisted.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Perform the pre-ride inspection
steps.instruction: Physically complete PDF90: coolant/fuel/oil levels and no leaks; sequential shifts and smooth clutch; effective brakes; full throttle return and3–6mm free play; aligned lubricated chain; wheels/spokes/tires; smooth steering without play; smooth leak-free suspension; unrestricted cables and secure connectors. Cold tire pressure is100kPa(15psi) front/rear. Correct failures before riding.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Ride the first interval
steps.instruction: Warm the fully assembled engine using its accepted starting procedure. In a controlled off-road area, ride about20 minutes at no more than half throttle. Stop immediately for a problem and record actual riding time/symptoms. Automatic stop after7 minutes idling does not make idling into riding time.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Stop and inspect
steps.instruction: Check mounted areas for looseness and oil or other leaks. Resolve any problem before continuing. Record actual findings; a symptom-free interval does not complete post-break-in maintenance.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Complete the recorded parts route
steps.instruction: For valves/piston/rings without cylinder replacement, ride about10 further minutes at no more than half throttle. For a new cylinder, ride about40 further minutes; with new valves/piston/rings too, retain half throttle for the first10 minutes, then never exceed three-quarter throttle. Stop for abnormal behavior and record actual time and throttle ceiling.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect before maintenance
steps.instruction: Stop and thoroughly inspect mounted areas and leakage, cable stretch, brake action/free play, chain stretch and loose spokes. The riding period is complete only for the recorded parts route; maintenance below remains unfinished.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Drain and inspect the used oil
steps.instruction: Upright on level ground, warm the engine several minutes and stop. Place a clean container under both drains. Remove filler cap/O-ring and crankcase/oil-tank drain bolts with gaskets; drain both compartments completely. Inspect for dirt and foreign material, especially metal chips. If present, stop: Yamaha requires crankcase disassembly/inspection, not merely fresh oil and a passed record.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Renew the oil filter
steps.instruction: This route deliberately includes a new filter with the required oil change. Remove cover/filter, renew the cover O-ring and fit the exact new filter in the PDF99 orientation. Refit cover bolts at10Nm. The post-break-in paragraph itself does not separately mandate filter replacement.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Expose the generator mounting check
steps.instruction: With oil drained, remove sub-seat/seat, filter-case cover and left shroud. Label/disconnect stator and crank-position couplers. Remove the shift pedal, preserving punch-mark alignment, and retain both external lead clamps/holder. PDF240–242 supports this access with the engine installed.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Open the left cover only
steps.instruction: Release cover fasteners progressively and lift the cover without pulling wires. Retain both dowels and holders/clamps; discard the gasket. Keep stator/grommet attached to the cover and rotor attached to the shaft. Secure assemblies do not need removal merely for a mounting inspection.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect generator mounting
steps.instruction: Check rotor/stator mounted areas for looseness and visible contact damage; inspect connectors. Record actual inspection. A loose or damaged assembly requires separate reviewed generator repair, not blind tightening. Repair reference values are stator/sensor10Nm with source LOCTITE and rotor65Nm, but removal, clean taper/key seating and retention belong to that repair.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Reseal the left side
steps.instruction: Fit both dowels and a new cover gasket. Restore cover/holders/clamps and tighten bolts in stages and crisscross to10Nm. Keep the undisturbed grommet sealed and wires unpinched. Align pedal/shaft punch marks, tighten pedal bolt12Nm, reconnect both couplers and restore the illustrated lead routing.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Close drains and refill
steps.instruction: Use new gaskets: oil-tank drain10Nm, crankcase drain20Nm. Fill0.96L for this filter-removal service, then fit filler cap with a new O-ring. Use Yamalube/API SG-or-higher/JASO MA, selecting10W-40,10W-50,15W-40,20W-40 or20W-50 against PDF98 temperature chart. No additives or source-prohibited CD-or-higher/ENERGY CONSERVING II oils. Final settled level governs;1.20L disassembled capacity is not this service fill.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect the repaired engine
steps.instruction: Check head/cylinder and crankcase/cover joints for pressure/oil leaks and cooling-system leakage. Check silencer body/stay for cracks/leaks and engine mounts for loosening. Record the PDF41 repaired-part fit/contact assessment with the repair specialist where needed. Accepted old dimensions alone are not a fresh inspection of inaccessible surfaces; any suspect fit must be resolved before completion.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect chassis and wheels
steps.instruction: Check frame, swingarm, linkage and bracket welds/mounts for cracks/looseness; wheels for damage/runout and bearing play. A tilted tire valve indicates tire movement requiring correction. Check fork/shock smooth operation, leaks and mounts. Raise front wheel, rock lower fork legs to check steering play and turn both ways; binding/play needs separate steering service.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Check spokes progressively
steps.instruction: Compare spoke tones by tapping: loose spokes sound dull. Replace bent/damaged spokes through the separate wheel repair. Tighten sound loose nipples progressively to2.5Nm, never a half-turn or more per adjustment. Continue staged checks until initial looseness disappears; record unresolved wheel faults.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set chain alignment and slack
steps.instruction: With rear wheel raised and gearbox neutral, pull chain upward about50N over the guide mounting bolt. Measure the illustrated gap. For adjustment loosen axle/both locknuts, adjust sides equally to50–60mm and push wheel forward to seat end plates. Tighten axle135Nm and both locknuts21Nm, then recheck. Lubricate using the reviewed chain-maintenance method.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect and lubricate controls
steps.instruction: Check brake effectiveness/no drag and front-lever end free play; inspect hoses for leaks. Horizontal brake reservoirs must be above PDF109 minimum marks. Low/leaking/spongy systems require separate brake service. Check clutch leakage/operation. Inspect cables through steering/travel; lubricate rough sound cables with engine oil or suitable cable lubricant at the upright cable end. Use silicone grease on brake-lever pivot/contact and lithium-soap grease on clutch-lever/pedal pivots. Repair damaged components. The clutch-lever lithium-soap instruction here is periodic maintenance from PDF119; it does not replace the separate silicone callout for master-cylinder assembly in PDF252.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record the required tank-interior service
steps.instruction: Yamaha PDF41 also requires cleaning inside the fuel tank and checking for leaks. This companion does not supply an invented solvent or undocumented cleaning method. Arrange that operation with the qualified service provider and record the actual cleaning, tank/pump sealing and fuel-leak checks before completion. The provider must follow exact PDF306–308 access/refit: protected disconnected fittings, tank supported off the pump face, new pump gasket lip upward if pump removed, pump projection aligned with bracket slot, five pump bolts tightened in the numbered diagram order to7Nm, tank front bolts8Nm/retaining screw4Nm, and fuel-hose click/locked cover plus pump connector. This external operation is required, not satisfied by merely inspecting fuel color.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Restore access panels
steps.instruction: Seat radiator-guard projections in the left shroud and tighten shroud fasteners7Nm. Restore filter-cover projections/ribs and breather routing. Refit seat bolts13Nm and secure sub-seat with untwisted tether. Check connector engagement, wiring clearance and every oil closure before restart.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Complete every applicable torque check
steps.instruction: Physically complete PDF42–43 against exact joint rows and conditions on PDF56–63: frame/engine/seat, steering, suspension/linkage/pivot, wheels/spokes/sprocket, brake/clutch fasteners, fuel pump, shift pedal and bodywork. Record each joint or link the actual inspection sheet. Inaccessible/unidentified joints remain pending. Do not substitute generic torques or open hydraulic unions merely to create a check. Lower steering-ring preload requires its separate staged service. No completion with unresolved required checks.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Check flow at idle
steps.instruction: Start fully assembled engine at idle only and watch oil window for flow and decreasing level. Stop immediately if level does not decrease; diagnose lubrication before proceeding. Do not rev it to force a successful check.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Verify settled oil level
steps.instruction: Use PDF97–98: warm oil to stated normal60°C (source says ten minutes; automatic idle stop may interrupt), stop, stand upright/level, run ten seconds, stop and wait a few minutes. Level must lie between lower window edge and maximum mark. Correct with specified oil, then warm several minutes, stop, settle and recheck. Record actual level/leaks; do not claim an unmeasured temperature was measured.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record actual maintenance completion
steps.instruction: With engine cold, check coolant at illustrated maximum and no continuing loss; remove cap only cold using cloth/slow pressure release and secure it afterwards. Repeat PDF90. Close only with actual riding/parts route, accepted oil inspection, generator/fit/chassis/torque records and required repairs accepted. Missing inspections or unresolved findings leave maintenance open. This record does not complete unrelated engine or shock rebuild work.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original source companion; combined-parts restriction and inspection records are explicit workflow adaptations.

external_operations.scope: Qualified tank-interior cleaning with exact source access/refit and leak closure. Cleaning method not specified in cited OEM; external completion record required.

unresolved_knowledge: Compatible actionable tank-interior cleaning method not yet established; qualified external service required.
All-joint access and internal fit diagnostics are not taught here; actual required specialist inspection record governs completion.
